description: Ilyushin Il-14 converted into a restaurant at Medzianky 18; the tactical number 3156 is transcribed into the map object as an inscription so it was read off the airframe; whether it is a Soviet-built Il-14 or a Czechoslovak-built Avia 14 is not established and both designations are recorded
